rootNode.apollo: Apollo channels {{type1}} and {{type2}} as one of the last lights pushing back the void's endless night. His radiant power may be the difference between survival and oblivion.
rootNode.diana: Diana weaves {{type1}} and {{type2}} into moonlit threads that track the void's movements, her hunt revealing where its darkness will strike next. Her guidance gives others precious moments to escape—moments that might mean the difference between life and erasure.
rootNode.brock: Brock stands as the unyielding stone between the void and those he protects. His strength is tested beyond its limits, but he refuses to crumble while others depend on him.
rootNode.misty: Misty's Water-type mastery flows against the void's corrupting tide. She knows the flood is rising, but her currents refuse to be swept away—not while she can still fight.
rootNode.lt_surge: Lt. Surge charges forward fearlessly, his electric resolve pushing him to conquer the void's challenges head-on.
rootNode.red: Red stands at the summit of all trainers, a silent force who speaks only through battle. His legend echoes from Pallet Town to the peak of Mt. Silver — the original champion who needs no words to prove his strength.

descriptions.forbiddenFormUnlockRunIntro: For this run: With {{species}} in your party and 5 Glitch Pieces collected, {{item}} can appear as a reward — use it to evolve into {{form}}.
descriptions.forbiddenFormUnlockRunNote: [color=#e13d3d]NOTE:[/color] To evolve into [color=#e13d3d]{{form}}[/color], you must have [color=#ffdd44]{{species}}[/color] in your party and 5 Glitch Pieces. Then [color=#ffdd44]{{item}}[/color] may randomly appear as a reward item.
descriptions.smittyFormTooltipDescription: For this run: By using the forbidden formula and giving any pokemon 4 specific SMITTY items, they'll transform... Use the Voidex for the specific formula.
descriptions.smittyFormTooltipHint: Forbidden corruption from the deepest void crystallizes into SMITTY forms — unlocking powers stranger than any glitch.
descriptions.glitchFormTooltipHint: Reality was never meant to bear the void's weight. GLITCH forms are what happens when it finally breaks.

descriptions.signatureAltBuild: A unique alternate form for your Signature Pokémon - unlocked by the strength of you and your pokemon's BOND!
descriptions.altBuildFlavor_brock: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s unyielding bond with [color=#e13d3d]{{pokemon}}[/color] shatters its limits. Through stone and spirit forged as one, a new form breaks free—[color=#ffdd44]{{altBuildName}}[/color] emerges, a testament to their unbreakable will.
descriptions.altBuildFlavor_misty: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s flowing connection with [color=#e13d3d]{{pokemon}}[/color] cascades through their bond. Like water shaping stone, their partnership reveals a hidden form—[color=#ffdd44]{{altBuildName}}[/color] awakens, born from their synchronized spirits.
descriptions.altBuildFlavor_lt_surge: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s electric intensity surges through [color=#e13d3d]{{pokemon}}[/color]. Raw power crackles between them, shattering limitations and unleashing [color=#ffdd44]{{altBuildName}}[/color]—a force of pure, unstoppable energy.
descriptions.altBuildFlavor_apollo: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s sunlit resolve ignites [color=#e13d3d]{{pokemon}}[/color]; dazzling radiance reshapes it into [color=#ffdd44]{{altBuildName}}[/color].
descriptions.altBuildFlavor_diana: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s lunar grace guides [color=#e13d3d]{{pokemon}}[/color]; under moonlit vows it becomes [color=#ffdd44]{{altBuildName}}[/color].
descriptions.altBuildFlavor_red: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s unbreakable bond with [color=#e13d3d]{{pokemon}}[/color] transcends generations. Through countless silent battles, a new form awakens—[color=#ffdd44]{{altBuildName}}[/color] emerges, embodying the spirit of the greatest.
descriptions.glitchFormFlavor_brock: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s unwavering resolve has forged a bond with the void itself. Through shattered bedrock and fragmented code, [color=#e13d3d]{{glitchFormName}}[/color] emerges—a testament to his unbreakable will.
descriptions.glitchFormFlavor_misty: The void's corruption flows like water through [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s determination. Where cascading torrents meet digital corruption, [color=#e13d3d]{{glitchFormName}}[/color] awakens—born from her fierce and tempestuous spirit.
descriptions.glitchFormFlavor_lt_surge: Raw power surges through the void as [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s electric intensity shatters reality's limits. In a storm of voltage and broken data, [color=#e13d3d]{{glitchFormName}}[/color] is unleashed—a force of pure, unstoppable energy.
descriptions.glitchFormFlavor_apollo_diana: Through the power of corruption, the void has empowered {{champion}} to use [color=#e13d3d]{{glitchFormName}}[/color].
descriptions.glitchFormFlavor_red: [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s encounter with the void has awakened something ancient — data from a forgotten era. [color=#e13d3d]{{glitchFormName}}[/color] materializes from corrupted memory, a relic of Kanto's digital frontier.
descriptions.randomGlitchFormsForRun: Reveals 4 random forbidden forms (Glitch / SMITTY). Choose 1 to unlock for this run.
descriptions.legendaryFlavorText_brock: The Void's corruption seeps through [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color] like water through fractured stone. What bleeds from his earthen resolve manifests as a legendary born from his own essence...
descriptions.legendaryFlavorText_misty: The void's corruption surges through [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color] like a riptide. For one shattering instant her spirit crests and breaks, manifesting as a legendary born from her own turbulent depths...
descriptions.legendaryFlavorText_apollo_diana: The void darkness waxes within you like a new moon consuming stars. What emerges from that night takes shape as a legendary—your radiance inverted into something terrible...
descriptions.legendaryFlavorText_red: The void trembles before [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s unwavering silence. From the depths of Cerulean Cave, a presence stirs — drawn to the strongest trainer who ever lived...
descriptions.trainerBondFlavorText_brock: The void cannot shatter what refuses to break. [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s resolve hardens, revealing his true, unyielding strength...
descriptions.trainerBondFlavorText_misty: To survive, [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color] becomes fluid—adapting, flowing, and emerging with techniques the void cannot contain...
descriptions.trainerBondFlavorText_apollo_diana: The void demands you evolve beyond mortal limits. You answer by unlocking the celestial power within...
descriptions.trainerBondFlavorText_red: Silence speaks louder than any command. [color=#e13d3d]{{champion}}[/color]'s bond deepens beyond words, revealing the true power of the silent conqueror...
